vehicle_v3_findings.source: Local Logs/wireless/v3, wireless-diag-19439667 and wireless-diag-23593054; sanitized state/log findings only

reported_behavior.wireless_main_display: Working, wrong LHD layout on coded RHD car

causes: The launcher waits five seconds for HMI coding; the controller checks for wcp_receiver after two seconds, fails and deletes its PID file before same-PID exec.
The accepted-session predicate correctly rejects the receiver without its PID receipt, disabling guidance, timing and receiver IDR cadence.
The input adapter's old periodic IDR was suppressed without proof that the replacement cadence was active; bridge startup after initial IDRs cannot obtain avcC.
Driver coding becomes available after the receiver has loaded its startup config, with no cache or request-time refresh.
corrections: Remove pre-exec HMI wait and recognize the exact launcher during preflight with factory-tested full pidin name formatting.
Preserve strict accepted-session checks; retain PID across exec and permit stopping the owned launcher.
Suppress old periodic input IDR only while an accepted receiver's successful cadence receipt is fresh; stale, absent or unaccepted receipts fall back.
Request a bridge recovery IDR on frames without valid avcC, with one-second retry limit.
Persist last-known OEM coding independently of pairing data, prefer live coding, refresh the pinned receiver's in-memory /info dictionaries for late coding.
vehicle_v3_findings.first_uncached_boot_limit: If initial /info precedes all known OEM coding, reconnect once after the HMI is ready. The saved value is available immediately on subsequent cold boots.
